dimensions.assessment: Affects fiduciaries of certain Employee Stock Ownership Plans, independent valuation experts, and business appraisers.
dimensions.evidence: a fiduciary of an employee stock ownership plan (as defined in section 407(d)(6)) may in good faith rely upon a valuation provided by an independent valuation expert

dimensions.assessment: Provides legal clarity for valuation methodologies without fundamentally altering individual retirement payouts or imposing sweeping mandates.
dimensions.evidence: Clause (i) shall not be interpreted to--preclude the Secretary from promulgating... any regulation

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue implications are mentioned in the source material.
Amends the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 to clarify adequate consideration definitions for certain closely held stock.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Employee Retirement Income Security Act of 1974 to provide a clear definition of adequate consideration

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change applying to valuation determinations made on or after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: apply with respect to determinations described in section 3(18)(B)... that are made on or after the date of enactment of this Act.

importance_detail.rationale: This bill provides a specific clarification for Employee Stock Ownership Plan fiduciaries using independent appraisers for closely held stock valuations, affecting private company retirement plans and appraisers without creating broad new federal programs or large fiscal outlays.
